## Passages
RESULT [curation]: Beats OpenCLIP ViT-B/32 trained on full LAION by 1.1 pp ImageNet zero-shot while using only 27.7% of the data and compute. State of the art on ImageNet zero-shot for DataComp Medium.
US [curation]: Per-cluster pruning rates suit weed data, where some clusters (e.g., near-duplicate frames of one species at one site) are trivially redundant and others (small seedlings, occlusion, rare species) are sparse. It also warns against a single global cosine threshold across all species.
CORRECTION [curation]: ICLR 2024 confirmed. +1.1 pp over OpenCLIP ViT-B/32 using 27.7% of the data and compute, and state of the art on ImageNet zero-shot for DataComp Medium.
